description.value: Marché Mon Pitou is a French-inspired sandwicherie, café, and specialty grocer in Vancouver's Fairview neighbourhood, founded in 2021 by two former career-changers with a love of everyday French indulgences. The menu centres on artisan sandwiches built on croissants, baguettes, focaccia, and sourdough, alongside morning favourites and house-made soups. An on-site épicerie (grocer) stocks curated French pantry staples, house vinaigrette, and specialty goods to take away.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 94m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is real, open, and operating at 1387 W 7th Avenue, Vancouver as a French sandwicherie and grocer. The menu page explicitly marks several items as vegetarian (v) and vegan, providing positive evidence for that amenity. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, wi-fi, water refill, or other cyclist-specific infrastructure appears in either the OSM tags or website content. The OSM opening hours differ substantially from the website footer hours, flagged in concerns.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (Mo-Fr 07:30-21:00; Sa,Su 08:00-21:00) conflicts significantly with the website footer (Everyday 8am-6pm); website hours appear more current (copyright 2026) and should be trusted.
OSM amenity tag remains 'cafe' but the business has rebranded as a sandwicherie and grocer since October 1 (year unspecified); OSM category may need updating.
No phone number is present in OSM or on the website; only an email address (info@marchemonpitou.ca) is listed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible café and grocer in Vancouver's Fairview neighbourhood with a vegetarian/vegan-friendly menu well-suited to touring cyclists seeking a food stop.
enrichment_extras.notes: Business was originally a brunch café/bistro but shifted to a sandwicherie-and-grocer format as of October 1 per prominent website banner. The about page describes it as 'bakery, bistro & specialty food store' — older copy — while the footer and front page reflect the current sandwicherie/grocer identity.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page marks multiple items vegetarian (v): Coronation Chickpea on Sourdough, Pesto on Focaccia, Petit Pitou on Bagel, Classic Egg Salad on Croissant; and one vegan: Garden Party on Focaccia. No GF options mentioned

wow_evidence: French-inspired sandwicherie, café, and specialty grocer... founded in 2021 by two former career-changers
